messages.subject: PhD in wildlife ecology, Solsona (Spain)
parts:
Hi everyone,

We are looking for a PhD candidate to apply for a FI grant from the Catalonian Government (Joan Oró – FI 2025). The successful candidate will join the Conservation Biology lab (GBIC) at the Forest Science and Technology Centre of Catalonia (CTFC, Solsona, Spain) to study the effect of the brown bear expansion and anthropogenic activities on the spatiotemporal dynamics of the Pyrenean ungulate community. 

Please find attached a pdf file with more details on the position.
Application deadline is 26th of July (2024).

Kind regards,

Ana Sanz-Pérez
Victor Sazatornil
